pooled.tpr_low_fpr_note: FPR resolution is 1/n_negative = 1/52 ~= 1.92% per ROC step. TPR@low-FPR is reported at the nearest achievable FPR >= the requested target, not interpolated between the two neighboring points, since interpolating on 52 negatives would imply a precision this sample size doesn't support.

per_attack_type_small_sample_note: distortion_optimization's present class has n=9; its precision/recall/F1/AUROC are high-variance and should not be read as a confident per-family result.
pr_curve_truncation_check: Verified against the saved PNG pixel data and the underlying recall array: recall genuinely spans [0, 1] and the plotted content extends to the figure's right edge.
